## Checksums

SHA-256 was recorded on **133** catalog video rows and **16** catalog audio rows. Each hash is the public MP4 linked from the matching DVIDS page, downloaded October 6, 2026. The bytes were not committed. Download-menu renditions were not hashed. Their size text is the text DVIDS printed, and their exact byte length is unknown where the menu URL did not return HTTP 200.

Catalog videos with no SHA-256 on the row:

- [dow-uap-pr057b-platform-observes-uap-in-east-china-sea-05-jan-2023-indopacom](../records/dow-uap-pr057b-platform-observes-uap-in-east-china-sea-05-jan-2023-indopacom.md) — DOW-UAP-PR057b, "[Platform] Observes UAP in East China Sea 05 JAN 2023 INDOPACOM". SHA-256 was not recorded on this row. The DVIDS id serves a different file. The hash of the file that id actually serves is on the catalog row whose title matches the DVIDS page.
